def factor(pricing_data, parameters):
    eps = parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-9)
    if isinstance(pricing_data, pd.DataFrame):
        df = pl.from_pandas(pricing_data.reset_index()).rename({
            '$close': 'close', '$open': 'open', '$high': 'high',
            '$low': 'low', '$volume': 'volume'})
    else:
        df = pricing_data.rename({
            '$close': 'close', '$open': 'open', '$high': 'high',
            '$low': 'low', '$volume': 'volume'})
    df = df.select(['instrument', 'datetime', 'open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume']).with_columns([
        pl.col('datetime').cast(pl.Date),
        pl.col(['open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume']).cast(pl.Float64),
    ]).sort(['instrument', 'datetime'])

    k = parameters.get("k", 10)
    df = df.with_columns(
        (0.5 * (pl.col('high') / (pl.col('low') + eps)).log() ** 2
         - (2.0 * 0.6931 - 1.0) * (pl.col('close') / (pl.col('open') + eps)).log() ** 2).alias('gk'))
    df = df.with_columns(
        pl.col('gk').rolling_mean(window_size=k, min_periods=2).over('instrument').alias('gk_k'))
    df = df.with_columns(
        (-(pl.col('gk_k').rank().over('datetime') / (pl.col('gk_k').count().over('datetime') + 1) - 0.5)).alias('raw'))
    df = df.with_columns(
        ((pl.col('raw') - pl.col('raw').mean().over('datetime')) /
         (pl.col('raw').std(ddof=0).over('datetime') + eps)).alias('Factor'))
    out = df.select(['instrument', 'datetime', 'Factor']).filter(
        pl.col('Factor').is_not_nan() & pl.col('Factor').is_finite())
    return out

def factor(pricing_data, parameters):
    w1 = parameters.get("w1", 0.25)
    w2 = parameters.get("w2", 0.25)
    w3 = parameters.get("w3", 0.50)
    EPSILON = parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-9)
    vol_window = parameters.get("vol_window", 20)
    smoothing_window = parameters.get("smoothing_window", 5)

    if isinstance(pricing_data, pd.DataFrame):
        df_pl = pl.from_pandas(pricing_data.reset_index()).rename({
            '$close': 'close', '$open': 'open', '$high': 'high',
            '$low': 'low', '$volume': 'volume'})
    else:
        df_pl = pricing_data.rename({
            '$close': 'close', '$open': 'open', '$high': 'high',
            '$low': 'low', '$volume': 'volume'})

    df_pl = df_pl.select(
        ['instrument', 'datetime', 'open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume']
    ).with_columns([
        pl.col("datetime").cast(pl.Date),
        pl.col(['open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume']).cast(pl.Float64),
    ])

    daily_range_expr = pl.col('high') - pl.col('low')
    sf1_expr = -pl.col('volume') * (pl.col('close') - (pl.col('high') + pl.col('low')) / 2.0) / (daily_range_expr + EPSILON)
    sf2_expr = -pl.col('volume') * (pl.col('high') - pl.col('open')) / (daily_range_expr + EPSILON)
    sf3_expr = pl.col('volume') * (pl.min_horizontal('open', 'close') - pl.col('low')) / (daily_range_expr + EPSILON)

    df_factor = df_pl.with_columns(
        z1=(sf1_expr - sf1_expr.mean().over('datetime')) / (sf1_expr.std(ddof=0).over('datetime') + EPSILON),
        z2=(sf2_expr - sf2_expr.mean().over('datetime')) / (sf2_expr.std(ddof=0).over('datetime') + EPSILON),
        z3=(sf3_expr - sf3_expr.mean().over('datetime')) / (sf3_expr.std(ddof=0).over('datetime') + EPSILON),
    ).with_columns(
        (w1 * pl.col('z1') + w2 * pl.col('z2') + w3 * pl.col('z3')).alias('raw_f')
    )

    df_factor = df_factor.sort(['instrument','datetime']).with_columns(
        pl.col('raw_f').ewm_mean(span=smoothing_window, min_periods=1).over('instrument').alias('smoothed_f'))
    df_factor = df_factor.with_columns(
        ((pl.col('smoothed_f') - pl.col('smoothed_f').mean().over('datetime')) /
         (pl.col('smoothed_f').std(ddof=0).over('datetime') + EPSILON)).alias('Factor'))
    df_factor = df_factor.sort(['instrument','datetime']).with_columns(
        (pl.col('Factor') / (pl.col('Factor').rolling_std(window_size=vol_window, min_periods=2).over('instrument') + EPSILON)).alias('Factor'))
    df_tf = df_factor.select(['instrument', 'datetime', 'Factor'])
    df_tf = df_tf.filter(pl.col('Factor').is_not_nan() & pl.col('Factor').is_finite())
    df_tf = df_tf.with_columns(pl.col("datetime").cast(pl.Date).alias("datetime"))
    return df_tf

    eps = parameters.get("epsilon", 1e-9)
    if isinstance(pricing_data, pd.DataFrame):

            '$close': 'close', '$open': 'open', '$high': 'high',

        pl.col('datetime').cast(pl.Date),
        pl.col(['open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume']).cast(pl.Float64),
    ]).sort(['instrument', 'datetime'])

    k = parameters.get("k", 5)
    df = df.with_columns([
        (pl.col('open') / pl.col('close').shift(1).over('instrument') - 1.0).alias('overnight'),
        (pl.col('close') / pl.col('open') - 1.0).alias('intraday'),
    ])
    df = df.with_columns([
        pl.col('overnight').rolling_mean(window_size=k, min_periods=2).over('instrument').alias('on_k'),
        pl.col('intraday').rolling_mean(window_size=k, min_periods=2).over('instrument').alias('in_k'),
    ])
    df = df.with_columns((pl.col('on_k') - pl.col('in_k')).alias('raw'))
    df = df.with_columns(
        ((pl.col('raw') - pl.col('raw').mean().over('datetime')) /
         (pl.col('raw').std(ddof=0).over('datetime') + eps)).alias('Factor'))
    out = df.select(['instrument', 'datetime', 'Factor']).filter(
        pl.col('Factor').is_not_nan() & pl.col('Factor').is_finite())
    return out

    if isinstance(pricing_data, pd.DataFrame):

            '$close': 'close', '$open': 'open', '$high': 'high',

        pl.col('datetime').cast(pl.Date),
        pl.col(['open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume']).cast(pl.Float64),
    ]).sort(['instrument', 'datetime'])

    k = parameters.get("k", 5)
    df = df.with_columns([
        (pl.col('close') / pl.col('close').shift(1).over('instrument') - 1.0).alias('ret1'),
        (pl.col('volume') * pl.col('close')).alias('turnover'),
    ])
    df = df.with_columns(
        (pl.col('ret1').abs() / (pl.col('turnover') + eps)).rolling_mean(window_size=k, min_periods=2).over('instrument').alias('illiq'))
    df = df.with_columns([
        (pl.col('close') / pl.col('close').shift(k).over('instrument') - 1.0).alias('mom_k'),
        (pl.col('illiq').rank().over('datetime') / (pl.col('illiq').count().over('datetime') + 1)).alias('illiq_r'),
    ])
    df = df.with_columns((-pl.col('mom_k') * pl.col('illiq_r')).alias('raw'))
    df = df.with_columns(
        ((pl.col('raw') - pl.col('raw').mean().over('datetime')) /
         (pl.col('raw').std(ddof=0).over('datetime') + eps)).alias('Factor'))
    out = df.select(['instrument', 'datetime', 'Factor']).filter(
        pl.col('Factor').is_not_nan() & pl.col('Factor').is_finite())
